title: Viva Insights: Agent 365 Dashboard adds reporting for third-party platform agents
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, access paths, PowerShell controls and licensing requirements are supported. Two minor corrections remain: acknowledge conflicting Microsoft guidance on the web app administrator role, and label third-party registry observability behaviour as Frontier preview.

claims.claim: Agent Dashboard policies are reached in Microsoft 365 admin center through Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Access Management > Turn Advanced Insights on or off > Feature access management > Agent Dashboard > Add policy.
claims.quote: Under **Access Management**, select **Turn Advanced Insights on or off**. ... On the **Feature access management** page, select **Agent Dashboard** and **Add policy**.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId AgentDashboard -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates the tenant-wide dashboard-disable policy.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Agent Dashboard for all users in your tenant ... ModuleId : VivaInsights; FeatureId : AgentDashboard; Name : DisableFeatureForAll; IsFeatureEnabled : false; Everyone

claims.claim: Individual web app access is added through Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Users > Add.
claims.quote: Under **Microsoft Copilot Dashboard**, select **Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard**. ... At the top, select **Users**. ... At the bottom, select **Add**.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone disables web app access tenant-wide.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant ... ModuleId : VivaInsights; FeatureId : Viva Insights web app; Name : DisableFeatureForAll; IsFeatureEnabled : false; Everyone

claims.claim: A feature-access policy can be created in Microsoft 365 admin center through Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > app > feature > Access setting.
claims.quote: select **Viva** from the settings menu. ... Select the **Settings** tab and select **Manage feature access**. ... Select **Create a policy**. ... select the app and feature ... Select the **Access setting** option

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId Agent365DashboardNonPublicAgentsVisibility -Name <policy name> -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide policy excluding non-public agents from the view.
claims.quote: Example: Exclude non-public agents from Agent 365 Dashboard view reporting ... ModuleId : VivaInsights; FeatureId : Agent365DashboardNonPublicAgentsVisibility; IsFeatureEnabled : false
